evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~1.7 to 25.3 ppm instead of staying at purge-floor levels
Temperature holds at 750 °C with stable heater power ~44%, so thermal control is nominal
Ar flow steady near 100 sccm setpoint
Pressure gauge not installed, so leak vs. exhaust restriction cannot be separated

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) to distinguish an air in-leak from an exhaust/flow artifact; an Ar flow step test to see whether O2 dilutes proportionally would discriminate.
